svg.title: Asset events and financing
svg.desc: Asset events and financing. Which asset event or debt installment links to a journal? Primary tables: FixedAsset, FixedAssetEvent, DebtAgreement, DebtScheduleLine. Asset and debt records link to journals when present; they do not post under their own GLEntry source labels.

div.div:
(PK) = primary key. (FK) = foreign key.
Solid crow’s-foot lines show foreign-key relationships; dashed labeled lines show conditional traces or analytical matches. See r1, r2… in the relationship table.
